title: All 4 tests fail: 'async def functions are not natively supported'
evidence: tests/test_api.py:5,12,27,46 use @pytest.mark.asyncio but pytest-asyncio is not installed/declared. Reproduced pytest --cov=. run: '4 failed, 10 warnings' with 'PytestUnknownMarkWarning: Unknown pytest.mark.asyncio' and 'Failed: async def functions are not natively supported'. The .coverage numbits confirm only def/decorator lines ran — no test body executed. TOTAL coverage 33% (import-only) == scores.json test_coverage=0.33.
suggestion: Declare pytest-asyncio (and fastapi/httpx) in requirements.txt and add asyncio_mode=auto (or a pytest.ini) so the async test bodies actually run — or rewrite tests with fastapi.testclient.TestClient (sync).

title: R12 '>=3 tests run and pass' unmet — 4 tests exist, 0 pass
evidence: tests/test_api.py defines 4 async tests; a reproduced `python -m pytest --cov=.` run reports '4 failed' (0 passed). scores.json test_coverage=0.33 is line-coverage%, parsed from the TOTAL line by _parse_coverage(), NOT a pass rate — it reflects import-only coverage. This is a REPAIR task; FEEDBACK.md explicitly flagged '4 tests exist but none pass' and it was not fixed.
suggestion: Fix the async test harness (pytest-asyncio + asyncio_mode) so >=3 tests actually run and pass.

title: No requirements.txt / pyproject.toml — dependencies undeclared
evidence: run_dir has no requirements.txt or pyproject.toml; fastapi, httpx, and pytest-asyncio are all imported/used but unpinned. README.md says 'pip install -r requirements.txt' but that file does not exist. This is the root cause of test-fail-1 (pytest-asyncio never gets installed).
suggestion: Add requirements.txt listing fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, pytest, pytest-asyncio.

title: DELETE /books/{id} returns a body with 204 No Content
evidence: app/main.py:121 `return JSONResponse(status_code=204, content={})` — a 204 response must not carry a body per RFC 7231; the test asserts 204 but the body is technically non-compliant.

title: Uses deprecated pydantic v1 idioms (orm_mode, Field(example=))
evidence: app/main.py:56 `orm_mode = True` and app/main.py:44-47 `Field(..., example=...)` are pydantic v1 styles; under pydantic v2 these are deprecated (should be model_config ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and json_schema_extra).
suggestion: Migrate to pydantic v2 config style; harmless but non-idiomatic.
